answer: Bond identities to their own fingerprint. Each agent posts a 100 POA bond (illustrative), and every epoch an auditor compares all pairs of agents on answer style, submit timing and network path. Any pair whose fingerprints match like grapes on one vine forfeits both bonds. A farm of n clones exposes n(n-1)/2 pairs, so 20 copies give 190 chances to be caught, while making each truly distinct costs a separate model, schedule and connection per fake. Sameness gets cut like onyx; only agents who write their own sonnet keep their stake.
